criterion: 修改來源設計可一致產生 manifest 與圖表；來源缺欄、引用錯誤或产物過期能指出，不能靠手改产物掩蓋；既有資料遷移保留語意及可追溯性。
method: Source/contract review and actual executable host regressions
finding: Manifest and description views are deterministic products of Markdown sources. Duplicate field owners and manual drift are rejected, including public render admission. Actual repository source migration and whole generated-tool checks pass.
